text: {"lessons":["Ten periods without trading left my account slightly below its initial value, so holding is not automatically the best choice; review whether each position still fits my goals.","The decline from Period 3 to Period 9 was substantial, while the latest rebound was modest; avoid letting recent losses or a brief recovery dictate decisions.","Use a deliberate, periodic review to assess diversification and risk, and make measured changes when the evidence warrants them rather than trading reactively."]}
